name: ZCA_SIGNAL_DEFINITIONS
description: ZCA_SIGNAL_DEFINITIONS: This table will persist the body of the Signal Definitions

columns.name: SIGNAL_DEF_ID
columns.description: ID column: the auto-generated uniquely identifying key value.

columns.name: SIGNAL_DEF_NAME
columns.description:
The name of the Signal definition. 
The Signal Name must be unique within an Owner Group.

columns.name: CONFIG_VERSION
columns.description: The version of the current configuration - this value is automatically incremented when the configuration information for the signal definition is changed

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of Event for the Signal (e.g. CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE)

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description:
The name of the Object for the Signal definition
e.g. "Opportunity"

columns.name: REL_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: The name of the related (child) Object for the Signal definition, if appropriate e.g. "OpportunityResource"

columns.name: OWNER_GROUP
columns.description:
Application Owner of the signal definition.

Will be provided programmatically for preseeded signal definitions.  Will be null for signal definitions created through the signal definition UI for integration use cases.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether this signal definition is active or not.

columns.name: CONFIG_DOCUMENT
columns.description:
A JSON document that describes the characteristics of the signal definition. 

Valid fields for this document include:
ChangeFields, ObjectPayloadFields, RelatedObjectPayloadFields, Condition, ExcludeCondition, RestVersion, PersistedFlag, StreamedFlag, TopicName, TopicKeyFields.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
